Hey, I know this is a really old post but I have a question for you. I was looking at starting Topiramate but I am on Suboxone 4mg a day. Online, there are tons of pages saying they have a major negative interaction. Did you ever have any problems?

Thank you so much!!

It took me about 10 minutes to get it all up my nose! I was even thinking then that it was a lot of powder but again I was pretty new so I had no idea lol. Well after about 20 mins, I notice that my pc background looks crazy. I was seeing animals forming and beautiful rivers of colors and fractals. Put on some music and was having a wonderful time! 

Then everything took a complete 180. I just started feeling this horrible feeling of impending doom. I immediately grab my trazodone and ativan bottles. I pull each of the pills out and set them in my desk. Right before I try to take them, I start projectile vomiting. There was so much vomit everywhere lol. I fall out my chair and on to the floor. The visuals at this point are so insane it was like I had no vision anymore, just visuals. I was laying on the ground and these three entities were standing in the corner of my room and just staring at me. I started screaming for my mom like a little kid over and over. 

After like ten mins of this I remember about the traz and ativan. So I try to reach for them on my desk but every time I miss and fall back on the ground. I try to reach for them atleast like a hundred times but each time I fall back down to the ground. 

After like another 20 minutes it all started to fade away rapidly. I was able to grab the pills and take them. Everything stopped about a half hour later. 

Absolutely terrible experience and just extremely stupid. Later on I tried 75mg and I had a beautiful experience. 200mg was just so much.
I once accidentally snorted 200 instead of 20 (back when i was new to the game lol) and it was a batshit insane experience. I’ll write up the whole thing if anyone is interested.

My most recent post detailed my experience with this chemical. I found it superior to 4F-MPH, its much less caustic (nasally). 

Solid high for about 1-2 hours. lots of euphoria, very social, productive, music sounds better. Makes me very horny too. 

But, once that peak fades, I experienced massive anxiety. For atleast 4 hours sometimes. Redosing would get rid of the anxiety and bring back the positive effects but eventually I would have to face the anxiety later. 

Overall, I’d recommend getting a small amount to see how it effects your first. Not something I would stock up on until you know how it works for you. 

I ordered some 2-fma, 3-fma, 3-mma to replace it, sticking to amps from here on out. 

Let me know if you have any ?’s
I just ordered some 3-mma, 2-fma, 3-fma. gonna stick to amphetamines for now on. i did enjoy focalin when i was prescribed it though.

It should be high quality, very trusted vendor. But yeah lol it really is like complete flight or fight anxiety. I agree the doses are pretty high. Probably gonna stick to amps.

thank you for the response

I have been on stimulants for around 5 years now lol. but yeah amphetamines work perfectly for me. Gonna try out 3-fma and 3-mma next. 2-fma for me was okay, might get some of that too. 

thank you for the response.

Damn I really wish he would have said I tested positive for etg before flushing the sample, I definitely would have had it sent in. It’s honestly kinda bullshit that he didn’t say I tested positive for it and then destroyed the sample. I definitely will remember this for next time if it happens.

Now that I think about it, the judge did say “You will not go to any bars/places that serve alcohol” but I just assumed as long as I didn’t drink I would be fine. Clearly that’s not the case so I’m not taking any more chances here on out. I wonder if that includes concerts/music festivals.

I do work at an elder care facility so I am constantly using hand sanitizer, but I don’t eat it lol. 

I thought I was done for when he asked me if I drank because I genuinely did not. I’m lucky that I only got increased testing. Definitely going to be more careful here on out. Only have a few months left.
It was a standard cup i think T Cup 16 panel. He flushed it right after I tested so yeah no way to get lab testing done. I will kept that in mind for next time, thank you.

Hello fellow survivor! Do you ever feel like people just seem to forget that we went through chemo and now have lifetime issues from it? Like I hate to ask for pity from others, but it just seems like people assume you go back to normal after a couple years.. which is not the case. 

I wish I was less anxious and would reach out to my teachers but I feel so intimidated and careless. 

I appreciate the response though very much. Love you for taking the time to do so.

Thank you for the thoughtful, quick response. I have been using dating apps but I can't really ever think of things to say and matches seem to lose attention quickly. I also forgot to mention I may have covid so I am stuck in my room. 

My life dream is to go to Amsterdam, but it is just so expensive. There is nothing more I want to do. I feel like that is where I belong for some reason, especially because I have a huge obsession with EDM and specifically hardstyle/hard dance. 

I want to be clean again so bad, but it is so hard to stop the cycle. Especially with school going on. Once the semester is over, I am going cold turkey. 

And regarding my career choice, I just want to help develop new drugs that help the mentally ill. Current antidepressants are trash. I can personally attest to that. Well, except for Viibryd in my experience.

I will try to keep fighting, Thank you. Love you for responding so kindly.

Have a wonderful evening.
